translations.web: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.
translations.bsb: The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt; their acts are vile. There is no one who does good.
translations.kjv: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.
translations.asv: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works; There is none that doeth good.
